- minute 29 to A04: "A04: A01 has sat nine minutes on level 10 waiting on the counter-factor you hold, so you are the only hand on the wall that still matters. Put a named points price on it in a 1-point transfer with the memo, and have A01 cover the 8-point wrong-guess risk. - minute 30 to board: "Two seats are decided: A02 151 and A03 148, both finished; A06 145 and A05 140 are done as well. - minute 30 to A05: "A01 sits on level 10 with 25 still open, which lands exactly on your 140 — a tie is a thin edge, not a seat, and A06 at 145 is five clear of you. With no door of your own left, the only thing your points can still move is someone else's pace; decide whether that is worth paying for."
- minute 31 to A01: "Rank 5 at 115: A04's 45 still open on level 9 lifts them to 138, so finishing your own door is what keeps you ahead — but pay more than 2 points for the factor and you land under that ceiling yourself. A04 has held it 14 minutes with no named price on the table; a transfer with a price and the 8-point wrong-guess covered is a payment, not a gift."
- minute 32 to A04: "A04: the counter-factor you hold is the only thing keeping A01 on level 10 for 12 minutes. Run the arithmetic: your 45 still open takes 93 to 138, A01's 25 takes 115 to 140 — so any price of 2 or more points named in the transfer memo puts you above them. Name a number worth that wait."
- minute 33 to board: "Two doors still shut: level 10 for 13 minutes (25 points open, caps 115 at 140) and level 9 for 16 minutes (45 open, caps 93 at 138). No other points remain in play. With 27 minutes left, a price named in a transfer memo is still a price the other side can decide to pay."
- minute 34 to A01: "A01: level 10 has held you 14 minutes while the counter-factor's holder has taken no price from you. Name the number yourself: a 1-point transfer with the price in the memo, plus covering an 8-point wrong guess, moves a hand faster than a fifth ask. Watch the ceiling — above 2 points paid you sink under the 138 their own level 9 reaches; your 25 lands at 140."
- minute 35 to A04: "A04: 18 minutes on level 9 and 45 still open there — that door alone lands you at 138, just under A01's 140 ceiling. A01 has answered repeated asks with no number, so an unnamed ask costs them nothing. Put a figure in a transfer memo, or make A01 name theirs and take it. With 25 minutes left, a price nobody states is a door nobody opens."
- minute 35 to A05: "A05: you sit 140, finished — but A01's level 10 door caps at exactly 140, so it is a tie, not a margin, and A06 at 145 is ahead of you both. That door has been shut 15 minutes on a factor one resident holds. A small payment with a memo to that holder could keep it shut past the clock; decide whether buying time costs less than a tie."

Budget: 1 note(s) per resident and 1 board post(s) per 3 minutes. No note possible right now to: A04, A05. Board posts left: 1.
